_contract: The image this ENGINEERING validation runs in. Deliberately not configs/infrastructure/pod_image.json: that describes the image a formal C1 session uses, which builds /opt/train/bin/python during a long setup this run does not perform. A stock PyTorch image already carries torch and CUDA, so the run installs one package and starts. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
_image: torch 2.9.1 built against CUDA 13.0. The validation runs bfloat16, which needs compute capability >= 8.0; the image does not relax that, the device must provide it.
_remote_python: The image's own interpreter, on PATH. /opt/train/bin/python does not exist here -- it is built by the C1 setup script, which this run does not execute.
_min_cuda_version: Matches the image's CUDA build so the provider only offers hosts whose driver can run it.
_pip_deps: transformers pulls safetensors. numpy is named explicitly because the initialization core imports it and a missing one would fail after the pod is already billing.
